description: ROM Ali Weapon Combat Attack Initializers (Sword, Bow, Bomb & Sprint Strikes)

routines.name: ali_sword_attack_dispatch
routines.purpose: Initializes Sword attacks: leap slash (anim 0x66, state 0x5C), running slash (anim 0x60, state 0x54), stationary slash (anim 0x4E, state 0x46)

routines.name: ali_bow_bomb_attack_dispatch
routines.purpose: Initializes Bow draw with SFX 0x600377 (standard 0x54/0x4C, Fire Bow 0x5C/0x4C) and Bomb placement (0x58/0x50)

routines.name: ali_sprint_dash_attacks
routines.purpose: Initializes running sprint tackle (anim 0x40, state 0x38, timer 0x15) and evaluates special motion cascades

routines.name: ali_mount_grab_attacks
routines.purpose: Initializes combat strikes while mounting/grabbing entities (anims 0x42/0x3A and 0x3E/0x36)

routines.name: ali_attack_commit_finalize
routines.purpose: Commits animation, state, recovery timer $FF198B = 4, clears input ring buffer count, and unrolls stack
